(function () {
var C = $262.createRealm().global.$262.evalScript(
  '(class C extends Object {' +
  '  constructor() {}' +
  '});'
);

assert.throws(ReferenceError, function() {
  new C();
});
})();



console.log("DS19 derived-this complete");
